macromolecule.details: Human MOSMO with C-terminal 3C protease cleavage site-TwinStrep tags. C164 is palmitoylated (PLM).

name.valueOf_: Human MEGF8-MOSMO-MGRN1 (MMM) ternary complex bound to nanobody 270

supramolecule.details: MMM complex was obtained by co-expression of MEGF8, MOSMO and MGRN1 components in HEK293S GnTI- TetR cells. The MMM complex was purified by tandem affinity purification. Purified nanobody 270, from E. coli WK6 cells, was added to MMM complex and the MMM-nanobody 270 complex formed on size-exclusion chromatography.

name.valueOf_: Human MEGF8-MOSMO-MGRN1 (MMM) ternary complex bound to nanobody 270

supramolecule.details: Ternary complex with MEGF8 and MGRN1 was obtained by co-expressing MEGF8, MOSMO and MGRN1 to form the MMM complex.
MEGF8 was co-expressed with MOSMO and MGRN1 to form the MMM complex.
MGRN1 was co-expressed with MEGF8 and MOSMO to form the MMM complex.

ctf_correction.details: Patch CTF estimation was performed in cryoSPARC live pre-processing.

final_reconstruction.details: Using map alone (d99), resolution was estimated in Phenix real-space refinement of the composite map.

particle_selection.details: 2D classes from a Glacios screening dataset facilitated template particle picking

startup_model.details: The high-resolution binary MEGF8-MOSMO complex (PDB 9QQS) and an AlphaFold3 model of MMM complex (with two Zn2+ ions) were merged and docked in the map using fit-in-map tool in ChimeraX.

image_recording.details: Images were collected in counted mode.

buffer.details: 20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 2% (v/v) glycerol, 2 mM CaCl2, 0.02% (w/v) GDN
